tracks.narration: How do you let many threads share a resource at once, but only up to a fixed limit?
A semaphore is just two things — an integer and a queue. The integer counts how many more threads may pass; the queue holds threads that have to wait.
When a thread calls P of s, the counter drops by one. If it would drop below zero, that thread goes to sleep in the queue.
When a thread finishes and calls V of s, the counter goes back up. If anyone was waiting, the semaphore wakes one of them.
Set S to one and a semaphore behaves like a lock. Set it to N and you have an N-way capacity gate.
